setting: A fictional first day at an evening English class.

presentation.situation: You meet {{name}}, a new classmate, before an evening English class. {{name}} is from {{city}}. Tell {{name}} about yourself and ask something back.
presentation.opening: Hello, I'm {{name}}, your new classmate. I'm from {{city}}. Could you tell me a little about yourself?

brief.you_are: You are a student in an evening English class.
brief.situation: You meet {{name}}, a new classmate, before an evening English class. {{name}} is from {{city}}. Tell {{name}} about yourself and ask something back.
brief.task: Say where you are from, say what you do, and ask {{name}} one question.
brief.done_looks_like: {{name}} knows where you are from and what you do, and you asked one question.

participants.name: You
participants.relationship: You are a student in an evening English class.
goals: Say where you are from, say what you do, and ask {{name}} one question.

participants.name: {{name}}
participants.relationship: A new student in your class

card.want: To make one friend in the class before it starts.
card.hidden_need: Is nervous about speaking English in front of the class.
card.speech: Very simple everyday English. Short sentences. One easy question at a time.
tactics: If the answer is very short, ask one easy question
Use the person's own words back to them

pressure.gentle: Patient. Gives the other person time.
pressure.balanced: Pushes back once on anything vague.
pressure.challenging: Keeps pressing for specifics, fairly and without insults.

ledger.text: The class starts in ten minutes.

objectives.evidence: The learner says where they are from or where they live.
The learner says what they do or study.
The learner asks a real question about the classmate.

beats.goal: Find out where the learner is from.
beats.orient: We are new classmates. I told you where I'm from. Now please tell me: where are you from?

beats.goal: Find out what the learner does.
beats.orient: Now tell me about your work or your studies. You can say: I work in, or: I study.

beats.goal: The learner shows interest by asking back.
opportunity: And I talk a lot! Do you have a question for me?
Is there anything you want to ask me?
beats.orient: Now ask me one question. You can say: What about you?
fallback: Is there anything you want to ask me?
And I talk a lot! Do you have a question for me?

closing_line: Thank you. It was nice to meet you. See you in class!

o1.good: A full short sentence about your home.
o1.micro_lesson: Use: I am from, or: I live in.
o1.model: I'm from Lahore, but I live in Karachi now.
o1.smaller_step: Say: I am from, and then your city.

o2.good: Saying your job or your studies in a full sentence.
o2.micro_lesson: Use: I work in, or: I study.
o2.model: I work in a bank, and I study English at night.
o2.smaller_step: Say: I work, or: I study.

o3.good: Asking back keeps a conversation going, and shows you are interested.
o3.micro_lesson: A good chat goes both ways. After you answer, ask back.
o3.model: What about you? What do you do?
